n.exclusions: Methods state 72 enrolled and no exclusions; target ANOVA denominator df = 134 differs from the full enrolled-sample expectation. No analytic n inferred from df.

replication.target_description: Experiment 1: partially-overlapping t-test comparing standard AMP effects with skip-AMP effects using non-skipped trials; within-participant task manipulation, with independent standard-AMP data retained for participants lacking skip-AMP scores.

n.sample_role: Participants in final analyzable sample for partially-overlapping t-test; standard and skip scores contribute paired data where available; standard-only scores retained as independent data.
n.exclusions: 21 excluded for completing in under three minutes or incomplete data on any measure; participants lacking skip-AMP scores retained through partially-overlapping test.
n.location: Author manuscript p. 15, Experiment 1, Participants and Design

reported_success.quote: We did not replicate the finding that standard and skip AMP effects are similar to one another.

notes:
Original full text not obtained: DOI/publisher landing failed or returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex list no OA location; Europe PMC lists no full text; primary-paper searches and author publication-page alternative yielded no downloadable original. No original statistics inferred from replication discussion. Replication is a conceptual replication (72 rather than 120 trials; valenced primes only), explicitly compared by its authors with original Experiment 3. Replication requested printed t statistic retained; paper also prints d = 0.96, 95% CI [0.79, 1.13], with caution about partial dependence. n = 295 is final analyzable participant sample for the partially-overlapping test, which retains standard-only scores when skip scores are unavailable. Replication title verified on author-manuscript first page; parent cached parse remains unchanged. Supplied p.7 locator corresponds to published-format results; precise locations here refer to independently retrieved author manuscript.
Source follow-up: Interaction F and same-test p verified on rendered primary PDF page 9. Extracted as a candidate central Experiment 3 test; target_match null because p. 9 also prints the priming main effect F(2,134) = 91.37, p < .001 and several other contrasts. Neutral description/locator does not identify which test is intended. Analytic n remains null; no conversion or df-based derivation.
